part: 1 of 2: C, D, I and J (R47b, R52, R53, R55, R58); part 2 is SYNTHETIC_ALLOCATION_CASES.json
replaces: the 046e naming examples (cps.naming-examples.draft.v1), superseded for C and D by R52

resources.note: INVENTED placeholders shared by every case and by EXAMPLE_INVENTORY.json. They are not the owner-reviewed company resources, which are private. context:brand_table is present only in a contract packet (a job without a 材料清單, O17); the cases that use it say "source: contract".
resources.context:company_name: 示例機電股份有限公司

job_inputs.context:project_name: 示例淨水場控制盤更新

assumptions: Unless a case says otherwise, the source is the company material list (材料清單, R47b) with the columns listed under resources, so the packet has no brand table (O17); the line lies inside the quoted range (R49) of the bill sheet that carries the prices, and every row carries L, M and N from the job inputs (R48) with K, O, P, G and H null.
Input cells are the line's own cells: description (a list when the item has continuation rows), unit, quantity, unit_price, amount, brand, model, remarks. A missing key means an empty cell.

Segments are separated by ，,、；; only (R52). A category chain is a run of segments before the item's own noun that only name a product category: a segment ending in 類, or a word in the glossary's category_words. It is dropped on every line type, but only while a later noun segment remains.

Expected values list only the fields the case is about; "row": false means the line gives no 未填 row and its cells take the stated census role. A row whose C is null has status research_draft with a null reason for C (R57; route v4.1 relaxation, kept in route v4.2).

input.description: 產品，控制開關類，選擇開關，30mm

cases.reason: Equipment line (switch). The glossary prefix 產品 is dropped with its delimiter, 控制開關類 is the category chain (it ends in 類), and the head noun 選擇開關 has a glossary entry, so C is its abbreviation. D is the rest, verbatim. C derived through the glossary cites the description cell and context:glossary (R58).

input.description: 產品，計時器類，限時繼電器，AC220V

cases.reason: Equipment line (timer relay). The glossary has no entry for 限時繼電器 and the line has no Latin acronym, so C is the head noun: the first segment after the prefix and the category chain 計時器類.

input.description: 產品，電錶類，電壓表96角型，附切換開關

cases.reason: Equipment line (meter). The head-noun segment 電壓表96角型 carries a digit, so C is cut before the first digit. D is the rest after removing the prefix, the category chain and C's leading noun part; 附切換開關 is not a rating token, so the comma stays (R53).

Equipment line (switch) with no category chain, no glossary entry and no Latin acronym. The head-noun segment carries a bracket, so C is cut before it; the bracket and the rest go to D verbatim. (綠) is a colour, not a rating token, so R53 changes nothing here.

description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC110V，

cases.reason: The continuation row is joined to the description with no separator. 電磁開關 is a category word the glossary lists, so it is the category chain; the head noun 電磁接觸器 has the glossary abbreviation XMC. 附端子蓋 is not a rating token, so its comma stays.

input.description: 產品，電線電纜類，600V XLPE電纜，3C，2mm²

cases.reason: Material line (cable and wire): C is null and D is the description without the generic prefix and the category chain 電線電纜類. Only the comma between the two rating tokens 3C and 2mm² becomes a space (R53). Material lines leave I and J null even when priced (R55).
PLC modules and software are material lines under R52: C null, D the description without the prefix and the category chain PLC模組類. CPU模組 is not a rating token, so the comma stays.
A valve written size-first, and any description that starts with a digit, is a material line: C null, D verbatim.
Service, labour and fee line: C null; D is the description without the generic prefix.
A single-segment description goes to D with C null, even when it names equipment, unless the glossary lists the noun. The glossary has no entry for 流量計.
Single-segment description (hardware) without a glossary entry: it goes to D and C is null.
Remarks and code columns never enter C or D, even when they read like a specification; they stay in raw text. 指示燈 is the head noun (no category chain) and has the glossary abbreviation XPL.
Rating tokens: each comma between two rating-like tokens becomes one space and the wrapping brackets around them are dropped.

input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，(AC，220V)，附輔助接點

cases.reason: R53 applies on every line type, not only breakers: the bracketed rating tokens AC and 220V are joined by a space without their brackets. 附輔助接點 is not a rating token, so the comma before it stays.

input.source: contract (no 材料清單 in the packet, so the packet carries context:brand_table)
input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC220V

cases.reason: Contract job (no 材料清單): a priced equipment line whose own cells state no brand or model takes the brand-table entry for its device type and rating band. The fields cite the description cell and context:brand_table (R58). With a 材料清單 the table is never used (O17).

A brand or model stated in the line's own cells (the material list's 廠牌 and 型號 columns) is copied. With a 材料清單, I and J come only from its cells (R55, O17). The single-segment description goes to D (R52).

input.source: contract (no 材料清單 in the packet, so the packet carries context:brand_table)

expected.null_reason_I: the brand table covers 無熔絲開關 only up to 100AT, so no entry gives a model for 225AT; the contract cells state no brand or model

cases.reason: A breaker whose rating no table entry covers takes J = the table's breaker brand (the brand its breaker entries carry; O18 gives them one brand), and I stays null with a reason. The glossary abbreviation still applies to C.

The glossary has no entry for 自動切換開關, and the source writes the Latin acronym in brackets after the noun, so C is the acronym alone. D is the rest after removing C's segment, with the rating tokens joined by a space (R53).

突波吸收器 is a surge protector, one of the equipment families (R52). The digit-free Latin acronym fused to the noun gives C = the acronym alone; D is the rest with the rating tokens joined by a space (R53).

input.description: 產品，控制開關類，選擇開關，φ30mm，2a2b

cases.reason: R53 on a switch line: the comma between the size φ30mm and the contact rating 2a2b becomes one space.
The material list states the brand and model, so they are copied. With a 材料清單, I and J come only from its cells and the brand table is never used (O17).
A single segment that is a glossary device: C is the abbreviation and D is the rest of the segment, here nothing, so null.

input.source: contract (no 材料清單 in the packet)
input.remarks: 廠牌：示例儀器 型號：FM-100

cases.reason: Without a material list the contract is the source. A brand or model stated in the line's own cells, here its remark, is copied and takes precedence over the brand table. The remark supplies I and J but never enters D.

Segments are separated by ，,、；; only, so this description is one segment. It begins with a glossary device, so C is the abbreviation and D is the rest of the segment (a single glossary segment gives D = the rest, or null). AC220V is not lost.

LED names the light source; it is not an acronym of the noun, so it stays in D and does not become C. C is the head noun of a lamp line, cut before the bracket. (LED) is not rating-like, so the comma after it stays; AC220V and 20W are joined by a space (R53).
RS485 is a protocol designation, not a digit-free acronym of the noun: it stays in D. It is not rating-like either (R53), so the comma stays. C is the head noun of a meter line.

A chain segment is dropped only while a later noun segment remains. 電磁開關 is a glossary category word but the last segment, so it stays as the noun. What remains after the prefix is one segment that begins with no glossary device, so C is null and D is the text.

input.source: contract (no 材料清單 in the packet, so the packet carries context:brand_table)
input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC220V

cases.reason: A contract line that states only a brand keeps it in J and takes the missing model from the table entry only when the entry's brand matches. The 電磁接觸器 entry is 示例甲牌, so I = its model. The remark never enters D.

input.source: contract (no 材料清單 in the packet, so the packet carries context:brand_table)
input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC220V

expected.null_reason_I: the brand-table entry for 電磁接觸器 is another brand, so its model is not used; the line states no model

cases.reason: The stated brand does not match the table entry's brand, so the table supplies nothing and I stays null with a reason.

input.source: contract (no 材料清單 in the packet, so the packet carries context:brand_table)
input.description: 產品，電磁開關，電磁接觸器，AC220V

cases.reason: A contract line that states only a model takes the brand from the table entry only when the entry's brand matches the model, that is when the entry lists that model. The 電磁接觸器 entry lists XM-10, so J = its brand.

input.description: 產品，指示燈類，AC220V 指示燈

cases.reason: After the prefix and the 類 chain one segment remains, so C null and D = the text (R52 rule 3); with more segments, a noun segment whose first token contains a digit is also C null (rule 4 note).
A noun segment whose first token contains a digit gives C null and D the text (R52).
Acronym alone in C; D keeps the rest after the noun and its acronym (R52 rule 2).
